name: group_by_uses_a_query_alias
description: @group_by naming a query alias rather than the table matches no column and is reported instead of emitting an empty parent row type
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE orders (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), total NUMERIC);
query_sql:
-- @name GetUsersWithOrders
-- @returns :grouped
-- @group_by u.id
SELECT u.id, u.name, o.id AS order_id, o.total
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;

error.message_contains: matched none of the query's result columns
